GARDENA CITY COUNCIL

  Website: www.cityofgardena.org

TASHA CERDA, Mayor  MINA SEMENZA, City Clerk
MARK E. HENDERSON, Mayor Pro Tem  GUY H. MATO, City Treasurer
RODNEY G. TANAKA, Council Member  CLINT OSORIO, City Manager
PAULETTE C. FRANCIS, Council Member  CARMEN VASQUEZ, City Attorney
WANDA LOVE, Council Member  LISA KRANITZ, Assistant City Attorney

If you would like to participate in this meeting, you can participate via the following
options:
  1. VIEW THE MEETING live on SPECTRUM CHANNEL 22 or ONLINE at
  youtube.com/CityofGardena

  2. PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING by emailing the Deputy City Clerk at
  publiccomment@cityofgardena.org by 5:00p.m. on the day of the meeting and write
  "Public Comment" in the subject line.

  3. ATTEND THE MEETING IN PERSON

  PUBLIC COMMENT: The City Council will hear from the public on any item on the
  agenda or any item of interest that is not on the agenda at the following times:
  Agenda Items – At the time the City Council considers the item or during Oral
  Communications
  Non-agenda Items – During Oral Communications
  Public Hearings – At the time for Public Hearings listed on the Agenda
  If you wish to address the Council, please complete a “Speaker Request” form and
  present it to the City Clerk or Sergeant of Arms. You will be called to the podium by
  name when it is your turn to address the Council. The City Council cannot legally take
  action on any item not scheduled on the Agenda. Such items may be referred for
  administrative action or scheduled on a future Agenda. Members of the public wishing to
  address the City Council will be given three (3) minutes to speak.

  4. The City of Gardena, in complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA),
  requests individuals who require special accommodations to access, attend and/or
  participate in the City meeting due to disability, to please contact the City Clerk's Office
  by phone (310) 217-9565 or email cityclerk@cityofgardena.org at least 24 business
  hours prior to the scheduled general meeting to ensure assistance is provided. Assistive
  listening devices are available.
  1
 STANDARDS OF BEHAVIOR THAT PROMOTE CIVILITY AT ALL PUBLIC MEETINGS

  Treat everyone courteously;
  Listen to others respectfully;
  Exercise self-control;
  Give open-minded consideration to all viewpoints;
  Focus on the issues and avoid personalizing debate; and
  Embrace respectful disagreement and dissent as democratic rights, inherent
  components of an inclusive public process, and tools for forging sound decisions

Thank you for your attendance and cooperation

  3.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Gabriela Garcia and Victor Avina, both in the 5th grade from Denker Avenue School, led the
  Pledge of Allegiance. Gabriela is a part of the Student Council and loves to dance, draw and
  visit Disneyland. She enjoys drawing Disney movie characters, especially the Star War
  characters. She is the Korean Dual Language Program at Denker and performed the Korean
  traditional fan dance at the 30-year anniversary celebration. She can even say the U.S.
  pledge of allegiance in Korean.

  Victor has been a member of the Student Council for the last two years. He has consistently
  demonstrated the three most important Denker Bear qualities: respect, responsibility, and
  safety. He loves to draw and is a foodie who loves to try new things. He plays football and
  basketball. He loves his family and his dog Daisy.

  Both students introduced their parents and Victor asked Mayor Cerda about allowing dogs

  21. CITY MANAGER REMARKS RE: DIRECTIVES / COUNCIL ITEMS

  1) A memo in your packets regarding senior meals.

  22. COUNCIL REMARKS

  1) MAYOR PRO TEM HENDERSON – Since the last meeting he had his ICA eboard
  meeting as they set up our program for our summer seminar in Coronado, California.
  This will take place the second weekend in July. He also, attended his SCAG meeting,
  of my community economic and housing development subcommittee, along with his
  regional council meeting. He came with some good knowledge; he will be formulating it
  before sending it over to the City Manager for discussion. He attended his post VFW,
  post 3261, and our job fair, for it being our very first job fair it went well. He is looking
  forward to doing another one. He also attended the Los Angeles Urban League awards
  dinner; it was also a great opportunity to understand what Urban League is still doing in
  our community and in our surrounding areas.

  2) COUNCIL MEMBER FRANCIS – Since the last meeting she attended the Los Angeles
  County Democratic Party regional meeting; she also attended the Gardena Boulevard
  ribbon cutting for the new parking lot and the Bring it on the Boulevard celebration on
  Gardena Boulevard. She also attended the Gardena Holly Park Homeowners
  Association meeting. She just wants to remind everybody now that its summer vacation
  time, there are a lot of kids at home, a lot of college students are back home, so there
  will be a lot of activities like bicycle riding at the parks and on the streets; she wants us
  to keep a watchful eye for our young people who are on their cell phones and not paying
  attention as they cross the street. She also wants to encourage everybody to participate
  in the programs at the Masao Satow and Mayme Dear libraries. As a teacher she wants
  to encourage summer reading to help prevent summer slide. Last but not least, she said
  I know there’s a lot of bad news going on that you hear on the radio, on television, and
  when talking with your friends. It seems that the world is getting crazier, and things aren’t
  getting any better, but I just want you to make sure to keep the faith and just know better
  days are coming.

  3) COUNCIL MEMBER TANAKA – Since the last meeting he attended the Gardena
  Boulevard event. He thanked Stephany for her staff doing a great job and her hot links
  were awesome. The dedication of the new parking lot seemed to go very well. He
  attended an event in San Pedro Elks Lodge to honor our South Bay COG’s executive
  director and Jacki Bacharach, she received an award that was called the inspiration
  award. It was an event to honor her as well as the Farmers Merchant Bank,
  Congratulations. The next day he met with Jacki to discuss his upcoming COG Chair
  responsibilities and expectations. He went ahead and thanked City Manager and his staff
  for presenting the community finance program. He attended his Cal Cities LA division
  monthly meeting, and it was really awesome because it was held at the U.S. Air force
  space command, he got a walking tour; it’s quite a place he was totally impressed. He
  got to cheer on the Gardena Police Department team that carried the Special Olympic
  torch on their run. He said we last did it back in 2019 but this was a really great
  representation by our department, and we got really good press from Channel 11 news
  that day. Yesterday, he was able to attend the Gardena Police Foundation golf
  tournament. He is a silver sponsor, and he congratulated our own Police Department.
  Gardena PD came in first, winning for the third time. He thanked all the volunteers and

  6
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 955C1E7B-63BC-4A01-8BAD-4910083F4E3F

  all those with Liz that worked hard to put this event together. Lastly, he Congratulated
  Lieutenant Messina on his promotion today. He never thought in the years that he has
  known him that he was ever going to do this, but he thinks the Chief and a lot of the
  command staff encouraged him, it’s a good move for him and he congratulated him on
  his marriage proposal at the same time it was very exciting.

  4) MAYOR CERDA – Since the last Council Meeting, she also attended the Gardena VFW
  first job fair. It was overall a great event; a lot of different companies attended and came
  out to support. She was happy she was able to attend. There was a great guest speaker,
  Jan Vogel, that gave great encouragement to those who were looking for a job. She also
  attended the Bring it on the Boulevard event, to parks and rec team: another successful
  event for you guys. Also attended the ribbon cutting for the new parking lot in Gardena
  Boulevard. She just wants to let the business owners and the residents on that street
  know that we heard you at the neighborhood watch meeting;about the concerns that you
  had as it related to parking and she is happy to say that not only did we hear you but we
  acted on that; and the parking lot that was available we were able to purchase it and
  hopefully this will help that street out. As soon as they did the ribbon cutting, they had
  cars parked there. She feels like that was a great thing. She also attended the
  Community Budget Forum; She wants to commend the City Manager as well as Director
  Beeman. They did a great job, it was a lot of information, especially for the residents, you
  guys made it interesting. She attended the 2024 law enforcement Special Olympics torch
  run with our Police Department, she thanked the officers that were out there running,
  they ran 2.4 miles from Raising Canes to Farmer Boys. It was a happy day for everyone
  out there, having the drone shots, having the K9 dog out there running as well, everyone
  was happy that we were able to participate in that. She also attended the Gardena Police
  Foundation Golf tournament. It was a great turnout, happy to see all the different
  businesses that came out to support. The Foundation does so much for our community
  from scholarships to helping out our Police Department. This benefits us as a city, as a
  whole. It’s a small group of foundation members but they do so much for our community.
  Lastly, she attended the promotion ceremony for Lieutenant Brian Messina, and he
  surprised us all with his proposal to his girlfriend, which she thinks this is the first time it
  ever happened here at a promotion ceremony, so it was really neat, and it was talked
  about for the rest of the day. Congratulations to him twice he now and soon to be wife.

  5) COUNCIL MEMBER LOVE – Since the last meeting she attended the Bring it on the
  Boulevard event where she had a great opportunity to host a booth and meet more
  residents and help promote a power saving energy program through Edison. Also, she
  attended and had the opportunity to cheer on the Gardena PD as they ran with the torch.
  It was really great to see the guys out there, had a lot of response reactions when she
  posted the video on social media. She also attended the grand opening of the parking
  lot. She couldn’t even get out of the parking lot before cars were already pulling into the
  parking lot. She might make a directive for Clint to start doing the budget updates mid-
  year. Clint responded they would be happy to do that. Wanda Love said she was only
  joking. Clint responded in fact they will be starting a Citizens Academy one module is
  learning about the City budget and how they present the cafe and financials and all that.
  It will be interesting for our community to join that. Wanda love said I will commend the
  City on the update and explanation of the investments and the budget. It spun from the
  community and resident inquiries on how we invested in all that so, she did notice that
  the City put forth a lot of effort in trying to calm those waters and explain. She commends
  the City on that.
